饭糗茹草: (lit.) to live on dry provisions and wild herbs (idiom)
饭团: rice ball (steamed rice formed into a ball and stuffed with various fillings)
饭馆儿: erhua form of 飯館|饭馆[fan4 guan3]
驭手: person in charge of pack animals
驭气: to fly magically through the air
